Heavy Rain Causes Flooding in Japan, Highest Warning Issued

Japan has issued its highest level heavy rain warning as torrential downpours have caused streets to flood, turning them into rivers. The extreme weather has raised concerns about rising flood risks across the country. Authorities have not yet released specific casualty figures or details on the extent of the damage.
